text: When the blazing heat of August has only just passed is the best time to climb mountains. The foothills are covered with people who seem to have had just the same idea as me.

Two people nearby are staring at the man by my side as if seeing something incredible while muttering something in low voices. This seems to remind other passers-by, who also stop to watch. Some even fish out cameras and begin taking pictures.

He hasn't done anything special to attract attention, and is only—like many others—warming up in preparation for climbing the mountain. But I have to say if there's one thing that can attract so much attention, of course, it's definitely his phenomenal physique.

Biceps bulging like logs; sturdy pecs against which his shirt lay taut; a broad, strong and reassuring back; quads whose powerful curves could still be seen even under his loose clothing; and those calves that supported his nimble fleet.

Strong but not intimidating, his natural, healthy physique makes him look far younger than his actual age, and full of vigor. He's just standing there, yet still manages to give everyone the impression of a classical sculpture. Onlookers can't help but gasp in admiration: Such a strong and powerful man! So strong, so powerful!
Many people present may share the same doubts and sentiments. After all, in the public perception, jungles, glaciers, and other remote, dangerous places seem to be more fitting for this explorer.
But he really is only here to climb the mountain. We'd been chatting a few days ago, and he had invited me along for a workout...
It's just exercise, no need to put your life on the line...
Sorry, Joseph. It's not the weather making me so tired. I just haven't been getting enough sleep.
But what am I supposed to do... Elderian Ring is just too addictive!
I'd barely slept all week because of the newly released game. If he hadn't called me in the morning, I would have completely forgotten all about our plan to go climbing.

I splash some water on my face after warming up, and immediately feel a lot more awake. Joseph had rushed over to meet me right after a shoot, so it's a little rude of me to look so out of it while talking to him.
Besides, I'm not the only one that didn't have enough sleep. I'm sure I'll be just as perky as him, once we get going.
Totally not what I expected... It isn't long before I'm puffing and panting away. Forget about being perky... I'm even feeling a little dizzy.
Joseph, in the lead, is still in fine spirits. So fine, in fact, that he's playing some kind of echo game with the mountains.
I was too naive... We are simply not on the same level. He can walk for almost a full day without a rest. I can't believe I actually thought I'd be as energetic as he is.
This is awkward. I check the time and cannot believe we've only been going for twenty minutes... Is it too soon to ask for a break?
In that case...
Joseph seems to have consciously slowed down, most likely out of consideration for me.
It's not often there's a chance to get out and relax like this. Best not to spoil it by making him worry too much.
Who would have thought it'd be this tiring to... climb a mountain? I hang on and walk a bit more, and the cool breeze seems to have a soporific effect.

Joseph keeps increasing his pace... No, that's not right. It's me who's getting slower and slower. I need to pick it up! I'm already lagging, and who's to say he won't just have vanished by the next time I blink?
Easy enough to think that, but honestly I'm already going as fast as I can. And my anxiety isn't helping me walk any quicker, but is weighing me down even more.
Is... Is this what he meant by "not too much longer"?! Well, I guess from Joseph's point of view this brief period is nothing. I was careless... I should have asked.
Walking another hour in my current state is no joke...

As daylight slowly fades, the scene in front of me gradually warps into nothing but a blur. The refreshing coolness of the evening air permeates every limb, giving me the feeling of being immersed in seawater.
I look down at my hands, but can't even see them.
By the time I regain consciousness, the surrounding scene is plated in the muted colors of dusk.

I've seen him princess-carrying his colleagues back to camp in the show, but thank my lucky stars he didn't do that with me. Fainting while walking up a mountain is bad enough—if he had to carry me back down like that, I'd have to go live in a different city.
I love listening to Joseph's travel stories whenever we eat together. I don't know what wonders he'll talk about this time, but I bet they're worth looking forward to!
I remember I brought some jerky snacks, so I take some out and feed him... Huh? There's something hard sliding around by my ear? It's not a bug, is it?!
I gingerly reach out an exploratory hand, only to find that George was rubbing something in his mouth against my ear. I take the object from him, and find a round, blue stone.

While it is a beautiful stone, it isn't a sapphire like he had claimed. If I can pick up something as lovely as this just by climbing a mountain, I should probably go buy a couple of lottery tickets. But it's always nice to receive a present, and it deserves a good meal.
The photo of the gemstone displayed on the screen seems familiar, and I can't help but glance at the "stone" that I'd stuck to the bedside.
I should get Nikaidou to properly appraise this for me, just in case, you know? I certainly don't want to cause any diplomatic trouble.
...While I'm at it, should I go buy that lottery ticket?
I have to admit it is a little embarrassing to ask for a rest after such a short distance, but it is what it is. Leisure time is meant to be enjoyed, so breaks are fine whenever one is needed.
We found a roadside stall and sat down, ordering something to eat while we watch the world go by.
Chatting with Joseph always makes me happy. His straightforward manner relieves a lot of my guilt.
This conversation makes me want to skip the game with Kazuha Saionji the day after tomorrow.
Although I took several more breaks along the way, we actually manage to reach the summit by noon as planned.
Without any suitable comparison at present, I will reserve judgment about it being the "best" viewing area. But there's no denying it's one of the best places to see the city sights.

From the lofty vantage point, the city seems to have become an exquisite model—this is definitely a new experience! When I think how, not long ago, I was a part of this "model" too, a sense of wonder is added to the refreshing feeling.
Joseph stays silent for a moment, before smiling and patting my shoulder.
Joseph bends over and picks up a blue stone from the ground, his palm shining in the sun.
One could say I've learned a lesson today. If you can treat every journey like he does, then maybe there'd never be a moment of boredom.
Just being around him automatically lifts my spirits, no matter how exhausted I am. People like him, who know how to enjoy life, can always affect those around them with their vitality and energy.
Although it is a little cheeky, Joseph is clearly offering me a way out. I'd be an idiot to refuse.
By the time we walk down the mountain, lights have already been lit up all over the street. We find a cozy little restaurant and celebrate the conclusion of today's journey with a delicious meal.
Returning home, I place the "sapphire" carefully in a drawer, wondering when I can find a chain to hang it on as a souvenir of today...
But I never expected fate to only allow me to have it for one night...
I look closely at the images on the screen, positive that I've seen something similar only recently...
Just as I'm about to pull the object out of the drawer for comparison, the phone rings.
I can't keep this... This might cause a serious diplomatic problem.
Huff... The weather's nice.

{character:Joseph} Alright! Warm up, check!

{character:player} ...Neck hurts. Back hurts. Playing back-to-back Hanchan games has made me feel pretty bad.
{character:Nana Shiraishi} You're clearly not getting enough exercise, junior. Oh, I won with this tile, hee-hee.
{character:player} Ah, I was busy complaining and didn't even notice that 4 Han with rounded up Fu scores. Ouch.

{character:player} Mountain climbing...? I haven't been doing that for such a long time that it actually sounds like a great idea. But just to be sure, you do mean ordinary walking up the mountain, right? Not one of those extreme challenges like on your show?
{character:Joseph} If you're interested in that, my friend, then we can always find a more unusual route to the summit!
{character:player} No, no! No need! Thank you! Just a normal path is fine.
{character:Joseph} Finished your warm-up, friend?
{character:player} More or less. Let's go... *Yawn*
{character:Joseph} Hahaha! It's a nice breeze, but it makes people sleepy.
{character:player} Th-that's for sure, haha...
{character:player} Huff... Ah... Huff...
{character:Joseph} How... Are... You...?!
{character:Joseph} What say you to a break, friend?
{character:player} Ye-yeah! We've been going a while, and I'm already a little tired...
{character:player} If we keep going at this pace, how long do you think it'll be until we make it to the summit, Joseph?

{character:Joseph} Hahah! It takes a strong body to play Mahjong. Seeing as we have some good weather, why don't we get some exercise and go climb a mountain?
{character:player} How about we rest a little bit later?
{character:Joseph} Are you okay, my friend? I hope I'm just being oversensitive, but you don't look too great.
{character:player} I'm fine, really. It's probably because I'm not used to mountain climbing. It's been ages since the last time I went.
{character:player} Don't worry. I'm not so weak that I can't handle this little bit of hiking. I'll be fine if I go a bit slower.
{character:Joseph} ...Alright. Don't push yourself too hard, my friend. Remember we're here to have fun!
{character:Joseph} Hum hmm hum! ♪
{character:player} I feel like we've been walking for miles, Joseph. How long till we get to the top?
{character:Joseph} Let me see... We've been going about 40 minutes already, so I'd say about another hour or so.
{character:player} An, an hour?!
{character:player} Stop, hold up a second!

{character:Joseph} Huh? Oh... Sorry. I'm walking too fast, aren't I? I can't seem to fix this bad habit. The crew of the show always complain about this, saying that one minute I was there, and the next I was already gone.
{character:player} It's fine, I just think it might be time to rest...
{character:Joseph} Don't be in a hurry to sit down, and don't be gulping down water just yet. First, you need to adjust your breathing.
{character:Joseph} Slow, deep breaths. Try to keep them even. Here, you can use this towel to wipe your face. Wow... Your sweat just keeps coming! Are you sure you're alright?
{character:player} Yeah, I think so. Huff... Adjust breathing... In and out...
{character:player} ...I think I'm alright. At least I'm not panting so heavily anymore. Uh, Joseph—is it going to rain?
{character:Joseph} Rain? It's a fine, sunny day right now, my friend.
{character:player} How odd... Why's it getting dark?
{character:player} Who turned out the lights...?
{character:Joseph} Did you sleep well?
{character:player} So well! Definitely the best sleep I've had in the past few days.
{character:player} This is... The foot of the mountain where we started?
{character:Joseph} Yep. You just conked out, scaring me half to death, hahaha! You didn't wake up for so long that I brought you here, where you could get better rest.
{character:player} Thank you... But I have to ask, how did you carry me down the mountain?
{character:Joseph} On my back. Why?
{character:player} It's nothing. Just curious.
{character:Joseph} Don't you feel better after a good rest?
{character:player} Well, yeah! Definitely more alert, but also starving. If I ate a good meal, I'm sure I could easily run up and down this mountain—twice!
{character:player} Although, it's not the best time to climb now... I'm sorry, Joseph. Let me take you for dinner tonight, as it was my fault we didn't make it to the top.
{character:Joseph} Don't say that, my friend. It's my fault for not realizing you were in trouble sooner. Allow me to take you for dinner instead.
{character:Joseph} All journeys have a few small hiccups. We'll have plenty of chances to come here again, so let's not allow a small setback to affect our future enjoyment.
{character:player} All this talk of dinner is making me even hungrier! Okay, let's have a really good meal, and eat away our regret of not making it to the top!
{character:George} Screech, screeech!
{character:Joseph} If this little guy's rubbing your face, it must be because he wants to cheer you up too.
{character:player} Yeah? Well, thanks for the comfort, George.
{character:Joseph} He even brought you a gift, a beautiful sapphire! Hey, buddy, how come you never comfort me like this?
{character:player} Maybe it's because I sneaked him snacks! Such an elegant gift deserves one in return. So, George, this whole pack of jerky is yours.
{character:George} Screeeech!
{character:Joseph} Even though we didn't make it to the top, finding such a wonderful little treasure is surely worth celebrating!
{character:player} Then let us celebrate! What do you fancy eating? Your choice.

{character:News Anchor} We interrupt your program to bring you breaking news: During a recent visit to our city, a member of the E Kingdom royal family accidentally lost the gemstone from their ring...
{character:player} How unlucky! Losing something so precious on so rare a trip. Erm, this place does great bagels!
{character:News Anchor} The lost sapphire has not, at present, been recovered. We ask anyone who finds such an item to contact us as soon as possible.
{character:player} Sapphire... Huh?!
{character:player} No way! Surely that's too far a coincidence, right?

{character:player} ...I'll listen to you then. Let's find a place to sit.
{character:player} So cold! Has this just thawed...? But at least it woke me right up.
{character:Joseph} Cool. Did you not sleep well last night?
{character:player} I've been up late these past few days playing a new game. I'm sorry, you invite me out and I turn up with dark circles under my eyes...
{character:Joseph} Don't worry about it. It's hard enough to find something that really grabs you like that, so why not enjoy it while you do? That is called living.

{character:Joseph} The very fact that you are willing to leave your game and come with me here shows that you value our friendship. And that makes me happy. So there's no reason at all to apologize! Smile instead, my friend.
{character:player} Alright! Treat it like I hadn't properly woken up and was mumbling nonsense.
{character:Joseph} But I'm not going to lie, my friend—those are some pretty impressive dark circles, almost like you got in a fight. Be sure to have a good dinner and get some rest.
{character:player} Yeah, I agree. I do need a good night's sleep. That reminds me, Joseph... You came right here as soon as you finished the shoot. Aren't you tired too?
{character:Joseph} As long as you have good exercise habits, doing a little extra work once in a while is nothing.
{character:Joseph} Exercise helps with many things, including Mahjong. After all, it is a game that demands both the body AND the mind. It can never hurt to be in good physical shape.
{character:player} I've heard that before, from Kazuha Saionji. She has often told me that I'm not strong enough to keep up with her training.
{character:Joseph} Ahaha! Even I find it hard to keep up with that girl. It's tough that you have to train under her now.
{character:player} Whoa... If even you can't keep up, then what hope is there for me in such a short period of time?
{character:Joseph} Don't lose heart! If you can accomplish something in the short term, just take it as a longer-term goal and make short-term preparation for it.
{character:player} What sort of short-term preparations? Can you give me an example?
{character:Joseph} Let me see... First, how about training to walk 20 hours without stopping?
{character:player} Never mind...
{character:player} I think I've caught up on my sleep. Let's get back on the road, Joseph.
Again, we are just not on the same level... His "short-term goals" are probably considered "long-term goals" for most people.
{character:Joseph} Okay. As you wish, my friend.
{character:Joseph} We have reached the summit, the highest point in all of One Han City!
{character:player} Huh?! Isn't that Kana's advertisement? Even here...
{character:Joseph} Hahaha! Look at the scenery further out, friend.
{character:Joseph} When I flew by here in a helicopter, I thought it should be the best view in all of One Han City. And it does not disappoint me!
{character:player} Really? Let me see!
{character:player} Looking out at such a sight really makes it all worthwhile.
{character:Joseph} Hahaha! Most of the hard work of hiking is all for these kinds of moments. So enjoy it! Enjoy it, my friend.
{character:player} What about you, Joseph? Are you enjoying it too?
{character:Joseph} Of course! Making it to the top, conquering the summit—it's always a pleasure, no matter how many times you've done it before.
{character:player} As long as you're having fun. I was worried you'd be bored.
{character:Joseph} Bored? How so?
{character:player} I wasn't in the best form today, making stops the whole way like that. Fortunately you weren't disappointed.
{character:Joseph} I see. Well, my friend, let me ask you: What do you think is the most important thing for me before I travel or go on some adventure?
{character:player} Let me think... Is it being fully prepared?
{character:Joseph} Hahaha! That's a great answer, but even more important is the mindset. Wherever I go, I must first respect the journey.
{character:Joseph} Respect nature, encounters, the unexpected, surprises... Take every step with sincerity and, at least in my opinion, with this mentality you will never be bored. Also...
{character:Joseph} Good things always happen to you! Would you look at that! What a gorgeous sapphire. Nature loves to give us these surprises from time to time.
{character:player} Hahaha! For real! It's so dazzling, too.
{character:Joseph} This is for you, my friend.
{character:player} Eh? I don't know... I haven't done anything special, how could I take such a lovely gift from you?
{character:Joseph} Hahaha! Did you forget? You didn't get enough sleep, yet you still managed to reach the top of the mountain with me. Such perseverance deserves a reward. Good job, my friend!
{character:player} ...Thank you. Then I'll take it.
{character:Joseph} Found something interesting, buddy? George is calling us, let's go see what he wants.
{character:player} Let's go!
{character:player} I haven't sweated like that in years, but at least my back doesn't seem so sore anymore. I guess I do need to exercise more. I should hike with Joseph again someday!
{character:player} Urgh... Surely it's not the same gemstone, right? It would be too much of a coincidence if it is...
{character:Joseph} Did you see the news, my friend? I think I saw something familiar.
{character:player} ...Your timing is perfect. Why don't we go to Tenhoukaku later if you are free?
The reason for such attention is actually very simple. It's because he is Joseph, a celebrity and household name in One Han City.
{character:player} Perfect! Let's go, and we can think about what to have for dinner on the way.
{character:Joseph} Hmm, nice. Come take a look, my friend.
{character:player} Well, it's like what those two tourists said. Compared with your previous adventures, this mountain is way too easy for you. I worry that it won't be exciting enough for you.

{character:Joseph} When we reach the summit, we'll find a patch of grass and have a nap while the wind blows all around us. After we wake up, we'll walk back down the mountain to have a good meal. And then, we will have ourselves an absolutely perfect day!
